text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. While sorting documents in 
the academy, which was quieter than 
usual...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, Trainer! Sorry to bug ya, but do you 
know where the blue tarp is?

Thinking it should be in the storehouse, I 
stepped outside— and in the empty square, 
a giant mortar and pestle were already set 
up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's New Year's, so I was getting 
things ready for mochi pounding! Just 
wanted to lay a tarp down first, just in 
case.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pound that mochi and eat it up! Let's pray 
for good health right from our very first 
step into the new year!

I was surprised by the sudden proposal, 
but... all the students are athletes whose 
bodies are their livelihood. For New 
Year's, there might not be a better event 
than this!
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll help out too!
In that case, I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You wanna give it a try too, 
Trainer?! Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's make a whole mountain of mochi 
together! One big wish for everyone at the 
academy!

—Hmm. If that's the case, would you allow 
me to assist you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Rudolf?! Aren't you busy?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sound health. When wishing for everyone's 
well-being for the year, nothing could be 
more important than that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whew, pounding it together made quick work 
of it! Thanks, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I mostly just followed your 
instructions. You really know what you're 
doing, Ace.

"What's this, a festival? Let me in on it 
too."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, CB, you're here too! That's a big 
help! Come on, help me roll the mochi!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, C.B.... aren't these mochi sizes way 
too uneven...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, really? Isn't having a good balance 
of work and play nice?

text_block_list.name: Gathering Students
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? Those three are making mochi!? Was 
there some kind of event today...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like everyone's gathered around! 
—Hey, guys! Who wants some mochi?!

text_block_list.name: Gathering Students
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure!? Yay, thank you so 
much!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! We've got red bean paste and kinako 
too! Eat up, eat as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Kind Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Ace-senpai... May I have some for 
my friends back at the dorm too?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The dorm? Sure, that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, since we're already at it! Let's head 
over and hand 'em out at the dorms right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Here, take 'em, take 'em~! Let's give it 
our all again this year!

text_block_list.name: Delighted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Is this mochi freshly pounded!? 
Thanks a bunch, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"You over there too! Eat some mochi and 
stay full of energy!"

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yes! Thank you so much! You too, 
Senpai... Good luck with the Classic 
year!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're cheering for me!? Hahaha, then 
here's one more on the house~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Made a giant pile and now it's all 
gone! I handed out every single last one!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once Ace sets her mind to something, 
there's no stopping her momentum.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was deeply impressed by Ace's 
initiative right from the start of the 
year. She energized everyone, and gave us 
a boost as well.

Katsuragi Ace and the others look 
thoroughly satisfied. Their mochi-pounding 
project, which brought joy to the whole 
academy, can truly be called a massive 
success.
choice_data_list:
You're kicking off the New Year with 
plenty of energy!

You're kicking off the New Year with 
plenty of energy!
Good work today, Ace. You relax now too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Sounds like a great opening act to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And with this momentum... we'll dash right 
through the race too! Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After moving around all day, it 
feels like just the right kind of tired.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! I should eat and sleep too, and store 
up energy for this year!
